subject: 英语
source: 人教版PEP小学英语（三年级起点）教材单元话题整理
original_text:
【核心词汇】eat breakfast 吃早餐; have ... class 上……课; play sports 做运动; do morning exercises 做早操; eat dinner 吃晚餐; take a dancing class 上舞蹈课
【重点句型】When do you ...? 你什么时候……？ I ... at ... 我在……点…… What do you do on the weekend? 周末你做什么？ I usually/often ... 我通常/经常…… That sounds like ... 那听起来……
【A Let's talk】Pedro: When do you finish class in the morning? Zhang Peng: We finish class at 1 o'clock. Pedro: When do you eat dinner? Zhang Peng: At 6:30. Pedro: That's too late!
【Read and write】I get up at 7:00 a.m. I eat breakfast at 7:20. I do morning exercises at 8:00. I have English class at 9:00. I play sports at 4:00. I eat dinner at 6:00. I go to bed at 9:00. I am busy every day.
key_points: When do you ...? 你什么时候……？
What do you do on the weekend? 周末你做什么？
That sounds like ... 那听起来……
cautions: 只做内容骨架（核心词汇、重点句型、对话与短文范例），不生成老师逐字讲解稿；词汇与句型均依据该 PEP 单元目标语言整理，不得编造教材未出现的单词、语法点或例句。
